non_public_module_classifications.surface: translation backend and extension implementation modules
non_public_module_classifications.rationale: The provider-neutral translation contract, filesystem registry, HTTP adapter, and application registry wrapper are internal implementation boundaries for the Custom HTTP translation feature; they are imported by composition and focused tests rather than exposed as external compatibility facades.
Underscore-prefixed symbols remain private/internal despite existing tests; later gates may migrate tests to canonical public contracts before removal.
ProviderVerifierAdapter is an app adapter implementation of the provider-verifier port; the adapter class is importable for wiring/tests but is not an external public compatibility facade.

MicrophoneTestCaptureAdapter implements the internal microphone-test capture port and is reached through application composition; its explicit exports support internal wiring and tests rather than an external public compatibility facade.

SelfCaptureAdmissionAdapter implements the internal Self capture admission port with explicit state and effect DTOs through application composition; its explicit exports support internal wiring and tests rather than an external public compatibility facade.

SelfCaptureSourceAdapter implements the internal Self capture source-factory contract through application composition; its explicit exports support internal wiring and tests rather than an external public compatibility facade.

SelfCaptureVadAdapter implements the internal Self capture VAD-factory contract through application composition; its explicit exports support internal wiring and tests rather than an external public compatibility facade.

non_public_module_classifications.surface: puripuly_heart.app.adapters Self capture audio loop adapter
non_public_module_classifications.rationale: SelfCaptureAudioLoopAdapter implements the internal Self capture audio-loop contract through application composition; its explicit exports support internal wiring and tests rather than an external public compatibility facade.

non_public_module_classifications.surface: puripuly_heart.app.adapters Self capture VAD sink adapter
non_public_module_classifications.rationale: SelfCaptureVadSinkAdapter implements the internal Self capture VAD-event sink boundary through application composition; its explicit exports support internal wiring and tests rather than an external public compatibility facade.

PeerCaptureSourceAdapter implements the internal Peer capture source-factory contract through application composition; its explicit exports support internal wiring and tests rather than an external public compatibility facade.

non_public_module_classifications.surface: puripuly_heart.app.adapters Peer capture target resolver adapter
non_public_module_classifications.rationale: PeerCaptureTargetResolverAdapter implements the internal Peer capture target-resolver port through application composition; its explicit exports support internal wiring and tests rather than an external public compatibility facade.

PeerCaptureVadAdapter implements the internal Peer capture VAD-factory contract through application composition; its explicit exports support internal wiring and tests rather than an external public compatibility facade.

non_public_module_classifications.surface: puripuly_heart.app.adapters Peer capture audio loop adapter
non_public_module_classifications.rationale: PeerCaptureAudioLoopAdapter implements the internal Peer capture audio-loop contract through application composition; its explicit exports support internal wiring and tests rather than an external public compatibility facade.

PeerCaptureAdmissionAdapter implements the internal Peer capture admission port through application composition; its explicit exports support internal wiring and tests rather than an external public compatibility facade.

non_public_module_classifications.surface: puripuly_heart.app.adapters Peer capture VAD sink adapter
non_public_module_classifications.rationale: PeerCaptureVadSinkAdapter implements the internal Peer capture VAD-event sink boundary through application composition; its explicit exports support internal wiring and tests rather than an external public compatibility facade.

SyncSecretStoreAdapter implements the internal asynchronous SecretStore port for the canonical synchronous store and is reached through application composition rather than an external public compatibility facade.
The provider runtime wiring module is the internal application composition adapter for the provider-runtime owner and is not an external public compatibility facade.
Application ports are explicit internal service contracts for app-service wiring. They may be imported by tests and implementations, but they are not external user/package compatibility facades.

Application services are internal use-case boundaries. Their public names are stable execution inputs for later gates, but this inventory does not classify them as external public import compatibility.

non_public_module_classifications.surface: vNext schema, resolved DTO, and runtime resolution modules
non_public_module_classifications.rationale: These modules are schema values, resolved DTOs, and runtime-resolution contracts used inside the vNext architecture. They are not legacy implementation owners and are not external compatibility facades.

non_public_module_classifications.surface: core lifecycle, observability, error-message, telemetry, and metadata contract modules
non_public_module_classifications.rationale: These modules expose internal core contracts for lifecycle, diagnostics, safe error/message shaping, telemetry ports/services, and OpenRouter metadata. They are not external public compatibility facades.

non_public_module_classifications.surface: Local STT download port and Hugging Face Xet adapter modules
non_public_module_classifications.rationale: These modules define the internal Local STT download port and its subprocess-backed Hugging Face Xet adapter. Their explicit exports are stable production wiring contracts, but they are not external package compatibility facades.
Provider error-detail helpers and managed local-model adapters are internal implementation contracts, not external public compatibility facades.

non_public_module_classifications.surface: managed local translation runtime and asset modules
non_public_module_classifications.rationale: Managed local-translation provisioning, runtime ownership, profiles, and package exports are internal composition contracts rather than external public compatibility facades.

The local decode coordinator owns provider-internal FIFO inference scheduling and lifecycle behavior. It is shared implementation infrastructure for local STT adapters, not an external public compatibility facade.

Output modules define internal output/message ports and routing implementation. The package-level OutputRouter re-export remains inventoried as public; submodules are classified internal unless separately inventoried.

Runtime-owner modules are internal ownership boundaries for runtime-only state and tasks. The lazy core.runtime facade remains inventoried as public; concrete owner modules are internal unless separately inventoried.
OpenVR vendoring helpers support packaging/native overlay startup compatibility but are not the public overlay protocol, startup, manifest, or snapshot contract.
Non-private UI module names are app-internal renderer structure, not external import compatibility, unless separately added to public_imports.
Event mapping and projection modules are internal Gate 4 UI/application boundary contracts. The inventoried public import path remains puripuly_heart.ui.event_bridge unless separately approved.
The Flet presentation adapter is the internal production UI composition boundary. It is not an external import compatibility surface.

The dashboard surface slot/intent contract and renderer are internal UI composition boundaries consumed by DashboardView and the later capture-control Goal, not external import compatibility surfaces.

The settings surface slot/intent contract and renderer are internal UI composition boundaries consumed by SettingsView and the later settings-migration gates, not external import compatibility surfaces.
The logs surface slot/intent contract and renderer are internal UI composition boundaries consumed by LogsView and TranslatorApp, not external import compatibility surfaces.
The about surface slot contract and renderer are internal UI composition boundaries consumed by AboutView, not external import compatibility surfaces.
The application shell slot contract and renderer are internal UI composition boundaries consumed by TranslatorApp, not external import compatibility surfaces.

The desktop overlay caption plan/slot contract and its Flet renderer are internal UI composition boundaries consumed by the desktop overlay renderer window, not external import compatibility surfaces.
The desktop overlay startup coordinator is an internal generation and readiness boundary consumed by the desktop overlay renderer, not an external import compatibility surface.
The Gate B Flet adapter, runtime, resource, token, primitive, and preview modules are internal UI implementation boundaries for later screen Goals, not external import compatibility surfaces.
Orchestrator internals are not public compatibility facades; public behavior is preserved through runtime/message/output contracts and tests.
The fixed translation policy is an internal owner and adapter contract. Product compatibility is enforced through production wiring and behavioral tests rather than a public import guarantee.

non_public_module_classifications.surface: puripuly_heart.core.audio, core.osc, core.stt, and core.vad implementation modules not listed in public_imports
non_public_module_classifications.rationale: These non-private modules are classified as implementation support unless an explicit __all__, existing public test import, packaging import, documented entry point, or approved facade appears in public_imports.

Domain-aligned grouping package that re-exports the moved Discord OAuth modules and registers pre-move import-path compatibility aliases; it is internal structure, not an external public compatibility facade.

Domain-aligned grouping package that re-exports the moved OpenRouter credential, PKCE, handoff, and managed release modules and registers pre-move import-path compatibility aliases; it is internal structure, not an external public compatibility facade.

Domain-aligned grouping package that re-exports the moved local ASR/STT contract, asset, catalog, download, and installer modules and registers pre-move import-path compatibility aliases; it is internal structure, not an external public compatibility facade.

root holds the preserved composition facade implementation behind the puripuly_heart.app.wiring grouping package, which remains inventoried as the public compatibility facade; the root module itself is internal structure reached through the package.

Domain-aligned grouping package that re-exports the moved peer capture adapter modules and registers pre-move import-path compatibility aliases; it is internal structure, not an external public compatibility facade.

Domain-aligned grouping package that re-exports the moved self capture adapter modules and registers pre-move import-path compatibility aliases; it is internal structure, not an external public compatibility facade.
Broker /v1 paths, envelopes, public error codes, and classes are public compatibility; Cloudflare worker internals are not public Python import surfaces.
Overlay startup/protocol/snapshot compatibility and Rust startup behavior are public compatibility; Rust module layout remains private implementation.
